item.title: Opinion: Does judging accreditation matter?
item.description: Despite decades of stringent vetting, testing and management by associations, there has been a noticeable increase in piping, drumming, and pipe band competitions that employ unaccredited people to adjudicate their events, and competitors don't seem to mind. And that's disconcerting.
